projectDescription: An AI-powered business assistant for freelancers offering invoicing, time tracking, file reconciliation, storage, and financial insights.
keyFeatures: Time Tracking - Live project time tracking with insightful overviews
Invoicing - Web-based invoices with real-time collaboration
Magic Inbox - Automatic invoice and receipt matching
Vault - Secure storage for contracts and important documents
AI Assistant - Financial insights and document search
Bank Integrations - Connect accounts via GoCardLess, Plaid, or Teller
Desktop App - Native desktop application built with Tauri
Recurring Invoices - Automated invoice generation and scheduling
publicApiSurface: tRPC API - accounting, banking, invoices, transactions, customers
Banking Integration - GoCardLess, Plaid, Teller connectors
Invoice Templates - HTML, PDF, and OG image generation
AI Agents - Title generation, suggestions, memory management
Background Jobs - Trigger.dev integration for async processing
Webhooks - Event notifications for invoices, transactions, banking
OAuth - Third-party app integrations (Fortnox, Slack, WhatsApp)
